Haines: Nvidia Board Better ‘Lawyer Up’
videos.description: Terry Haines, founder of Pangaea Policy, says Nvidia and its board face potentially prolonged scrutiny over Jensen Huang. Haines, who helped run congressional investigations into Enron and WorldCom, expects board members to be called to testify “repeatedly” as lawmakers examine national security and corporate oversight. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Rep. Dean on Huang: ‘This Will Not End Well for Him’
videos.description: Rep. Madeleine Dean, a member of the House Foreign Affairs Committee that will question Jensen Huang behind closed doors on Dec. 1, says his return to Nvidia raises serious concerns over national security and corporate governance. “This will not end well for Mr. Huang,” Rep. Dean tells Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Reinstating Nvidia's Huang Is a Terrible Mistake, Says Elson
videos.description: Charles Elson, University of Delaware founding director of the Weinburg center for corporate governance, says it was a "terrible mistake" for Nvidia to bring back Jensen Huang as ceo and president.
